Subject: Next steps — runtime fit pack, verified perf links, and prioritized prompt checklist

Hi Nora — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and three concrete next steps so we can move the pilot forward: 

Summary:
- Use case: patient triage + clinical note summarization (low tolerance for hallucination; latency target ~ 150ms p95).
- Keywords from the call: short prompt templates, 512-token context windows, maintain provenance metadata in outputs.

Recommended model family (prioritized):
1) redwood-7b-q8 (lowest-cost baseline; excellent throughput when batched; p95 latency ~120ms at 8 TPS on our hosted profile)
2) redwood-14b-q4o (better instruction-following and reduced hallucination risk; p95 ~ 160ms at 4 TPS in our verified traces)
3) redwood-34b-rt (fallback for quality-critical workflows—higher cost, p95 ~ 230ms at 2 TPS)

Perf artifacts I'm sharing (attached + links):
- Redwood-verified performance profiles (PDF): per-model TPS curves, latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), and memory footprint. See attached: redwood_perf_profiles_20260830.pdf
- Bench CSV: bench_tps_latency_insightmed.csv — contains the raw throughput/latency points we generated using your sample prompt set and 512-token context.
- Prompt seed pack: insightmed_prompt_pack_v1.json — prioritized templates (triage, note-summary, provenance injection) plus a short regression checklist.

Quality/regression note:
- We flagged two prompt variants from your set that exhibit instability when truncation occurs (examples in the prompt pack); if you prioritize hallucination sensitivity we recommend redwood-14b-q4o for the pilot and adding a lightweight reranking step.

Next steps (3 asks):
1) Please confirm who on your side will own procurement/PO (I cc'd procurement@insightmed.com for visibility).
2) If you want Dedicated capacity for predictable p95 SLAs, we can send a 30-day pilot quote + SOW — Laura can share the pricing & SOW.
3) Suggest a 30-min kickoff for scoping prompt guards and rollout plan (I can do Tue/Wed next week).

Attachments: redwood_perf_profiles_20260830.pdf (PDF), insightmed_prompt_pack_v1.json (JSON), bench_tps_latency_insightmed.csv (CSV)

Link references: https://drive.redwood.ai/insightmed/benchmarks/rdw_bench_insightmed_20260830

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez

Thanks Mateo — very thorough, appreciate the artifacts. A couple quick clarifying Qs from our side: 

- For the triage flow (high throughput during ED surges) we care most about p95 latency under burst; your note about 7b hitting ~120ms p95 at 8 TPS sounds promising — can you confirm the test condition (batch size, GPU type)?
- For the summarization flow (low hallucination tolerance), would you recommend starting the pilot on 14b-q4o as you suggested?

Procurement loop: procurement@insightmed.com is on CC — can Laura please send the 30-day pilot SOW and a starter pricing breakdown? We need line items for hosted vs. dedicated and a short note about rollback/fallback policies if QoR degrades.

Also: can you share a short prompt guard checklist we can hand to our ML team (we saw the JSON but a 1-page checklist would be ideal for our auditors)?

Best,

Hi Nora / procurement team —

Following up on Mateo's recap: attaching a 30-day pilot SOW and a starter pricing workbook. Top-line summary inlined below for quick review.

Pilot options (30 days):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): includes access to Redwood API, prompt pack integration, 100k tokens included, incremental per-token billing. Recommended model: redwood-7b-q8 for throughput testing.
- Dedicated (reserved small pool): guaranteed capacity for target p95 within committed TPS; recommended model: redwood-14b-q4o for the summarization pilot to mitigate hallucination risk. Includes per-month reserved fee + usage.

Starter financials (estimate):
- Hosted pilot (7b baseline): ~$3,500 (30d, estimated usage profile)
- Dedicated pilot (14b small reserve): ~$14,000 setup + $7,500/month reserved (pro-rated for 30d)

Rollback/fallback: we include automatic routing policies so you can failover to a lower-cost variant (7b) in event of capacity pressure; we will instrument quality monitors and can add an automated rollback on regression thresholds (per the prompt pack checklist).

Attachments: SOW_InsightMed_Redwood_Dedicated.pdf (PDF), pilot_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX)
